summary: Admin API 403s due to nested role claim JSON path mismatch in ID tokens for private deployment
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports intermittent 403s when calling Redwood Admin APIs from their private deployment. Impact: Admin users cannot perform repo and billing operations; operations blocked for ~25% of sessions. Environment: Private (on-prem) deployment behind identity-proxy, us-east region.

Observed behavior: Valid ID tokens issued by customer IdP include a 'roles' claim where role entries are nested under 'roles.details' as an array of objects (e.g., roles.details[*].name). Redwood's RBAC mapping expects a flat string array at 'roles' and fails to match, resulting in 403s for calls that require admin role.

Expected behavior: RBAC should either match nested role claim via configurable JSONPath mapping or the identity-proxy should normalize claims to the expected flat array. Steps to reproduce and logs follow.
steps_to_reproduce: Obtain ID token from customer IdP that uses nested role objects under 'roles.details'.
Make Admin API call to /v1/admin/repos with Authorization: Bearer <token> from a user that has 'admin' role nested under roles.details[*].name.
Observe HTTP 403 response and 'role not found' error in gateway logs.
logs: [2026-03-09T14:12:06Z] auth-gateway: token parsed for sub=user:123; roles claim present but non-array at expected path 'roles'
[2026-03-09T14:12:06Z] rbac: lookup failed for user:user:123, expected role 'org_admin' not found
investigation_notes: 03/10 Eng triage: reproduced locally by crafting token with nested roles.details[].name. Identity-proxy currently maps claim 'roles' verbatim; no JSONPath normalization for nested arrays.
Hypothesis: Customers with custom IdP schemas that nest role metadata need mapping rules to flatten into 'roles' claim. Our private deploy docs show examples for simple arrays but not nested objects.
Identity-proxy PR #902 includes a potential JSONPath mapping config; need to validate on private deployments and add automated normalization option.
comments: Maya Chen (Support) 2026-03-10: Reached out to customer for sample token (redacted) and confirmation of affected endpoints. Customer confirmed issue started after IdP schema change on 2026-03-08.
Ravi Patel (Engineer) 2026-03-11: Reproduced locally; will prototype a patch in identity-proxy to accept configurable JSONPaths for role extraction. Related PR linked.
Customer (StellarHealth) 2026-03-12: Confirmed workaround (manual mapping in IdP to flat 'roles' claim) restored admin actions; asking for permanent fix for future IdP schema changes.
workaround: Customer temporarily updated IdP claim mapping to emit a flat 'roles' array in the ID token. This restores admin privileges immediately but is not feasible for large IdP configurations or frequent schema changes.
resolution_notes: Patch planned for identity-proxy to support claim JSONPath mapping (PR #902) and documentation update to include nested-claim examples. Pending validation on private staging and release to customer via patch rollout.
